one_line: Cross-cultural king and monk of the Milinda Panha, debating Buddhist philosophy in Gandhara’s Greco-Indian world.

appearance.age_look: Menander appears late 30s, tall and athletic; Nagasena appears early 30s, slim and wiry, with a calm but intense presence.
appearance.face: Menander has an oval face, light olive complexion, straight nose, short trimmed beard and moustache, sharp grey-brown eyes, and a confident, inquisitive default expression; Nagasena has a narrow face, warm medium-brown complexion, fine straight nose, slightly prominent cheekbones, soft but alert dark eyes, and a composed, gently smiling default expression that brightens when teaching.
appearance.hair: Menander’s hair is short, wavy, dark brown, brushed back neatly, with a simple gold diadem band circling his head; Nagasena’s head is shaven clean in monk style, with no headwear.
appearance.costume: Menander wears a Greco-Indian royal outfit inspired by Indo-Greek coinage: a knee-length, belted chiton-like tunic in muted white-cream linen, over which sits a fitted, sleeveless light-blue woolen cuirass-like vest with subtle stitched edging, a deep maroon himation-style cloak pinned on his right shoulder with a small round bronze brooch and wrapped around his left arm, slim tan leather trousers, and calf-high brown leather boots with simple lacing; he has a narrow leather belt with a small bronze buckle and a plain gold ring on his right hand. Nagasena wears a modest saffron-and-ochre Theravada-style robe: an inner stitched under-robe in muted saffron cotton covering his torso to the ankles, and an outer ochre-brown patchwork robe (civara) wrapped over his left shoulder and under the right arm, leaving the right shoulder suggested as free but still modestly draped in this depiction, with the cloth falling in clear, layered folds; he is barefoot, with a simple dark wooden mala looped loosely around his left wrist.
appearance.signature: Menander’s signature prop is a sheathed short sword patterned after Indo-Greek weapons, with a straight bronze hilt and simple cross-guard, hanging from his left hip; Nagasena’s signature prop is a plain rectangular palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a dark cord, which he holds carefully in both hands or rests on his lap.

ref_desc: Menander is a tall olive-skinned Indo-Greek king with short wavy dark hair, gold headband, cream tunic, light-blue vest, maroon cloak, tan trousers and brown boots, carrying a sheathed bronze-hilt short sword, while Nagasena is a slim brown-skinned shaven monk in saffron-and-ochre robes holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two fixed characters from the Milinda Panha world: first, Menander, a tall athletic Indo-Greek king with light olive skin, an oval face, short wavy dark-brown hair brushed back and encircled by a simple gold diadem band, a short trimmed beard and moustache, sharp grey-brown eyes, and a confident inquisitive expression; he wears a knee-length cream-white linen tunic belted at the waist, over which sits a fitted sleeveless light-blue woolen vest with subtle stitched edging, plus a deep maroon himation-style cloak pinned with a small round bronze brooch at his right shoulder and wrapped around his left arm, slim tan leather trousers, and calf-high brown leather boots with simple lacing, a narrow leather belt with a bronze buckle, and a plain gold ring on his right hand, while a sheathed straight short sword with a bronze hilt and simple cross-guard hangs at his left hip. Second, Nagasena, a slightly shorter slim monk with a warm medium-brown complexion, narrow face, fine nose, shaved head, soft dark eyes, and a calm gently smiling expression; he wears a modest Theravada-style saffron under-robe covering his torso and legs to the ankles, with an ochre-brown patchwork outer robe wrapped over his left shoulder and under his right arm, the cloth forming layered folds yet keeping him fully covered, a plain dark wooden mala looped at his left wrist, and bare feet, holding a rectangular bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with a dark cord; use a consistent palette of light blue, maroon, saffron, ochre brown and cream white, and show front, side and three-quarter poses that clearly display their hair, faces, full outfits and signature sword and manuscript props.
